# Phase 01.1 Plan 11: Staff Provisioning and Device Enrolment Summary

**Staff roster, provisioning form, device registry and both destructive confirm dialogs re-skinned onto the Cena system with an own-line destructive control at 320px, the enrolment CTA still unbranched, and every contracted string byte-identical.**

## Performance

- **Duration:** ~14 min
- **Started:** 2026-08-05T02:38Z
- **Completed:** 2026-08-05T02:52Z
- **Tasks:** 2
- **Files modified:** 5

## Accomplishments

- **The last two of SC3's eight surfaces are re-skinned.** Staff provisioning and device enrolment now render in the Cena system alongside the six that plans 01.1-09 and 01.1-10 covered.
- **A long name can no longer displace the destructive control.** Both list rows became `flex flex-wrap`, and the confirm-dialog component sits inside a `w-full sm:w-auto` flex item — so at 320px the deactivate and revoke controls each take a line of their own, and from `sm` up they return beside the status badge. This is the plan's two backstop truths, addressed structurally rather than by trimming the name further.
- **Both destructive dialogs are byte-identical where it counts.** Their titles, bodies, confirm labels and the title → body → cancel-and-confirm ordering are untouched; the only changes in either file are the glyph route and contract comments. `git diff | grep -E '^[-+].*COPY\.'` is empty for both, and `lib/copy.ts` has no diff at all.
- **The enrolment call to action stayed outside every branch.** `tests/lib/unconditional-cta-coverage.test.ts` — whose table carries this page precisely because the defect shipped twice — is green, and the large comment explaining why the element sits after the ternary was left intact rather than rewritten.
- **Glyph migration on this plan's three client files is complete.** All three spinners now draw through `Icon` at 1.75, keeping their `animate-spin` and `aria-hidden`.
- **Mobile-first rhythm.** Page padding is the 16px step at 320px and 24px from `sm` up; the provisioning form's submit sits at the contracted 24px (the form's 16px gap plus `mt-2`) and is full width on a phone; the enrolment CTA does the same via `mt-6`.
- **The device enrolment date moved to `--font-mono` at the Label role**, which is the family axis's stated job (numerics and machine-ish strings) — while the device label, being a name the owner typed, stays in the sans body face.

## Files Created/Modified

- `app/(dashboard)/venues/[venueId]/staff/components/staff-provision-form.tsx` — spinner through `Icon`; 24px before the submit control; full-width submit at 320px
- `app/(dashboard)/venues/[venueId]/staff/components/deactivate-staff-dialog.tsx` — spinner through `Icon`; contract comment recording that copy, labels and ordering are fixed and that Radix owns the focus trap
- `app/(dashboard)/venues/[venueId]/staff/devices/page.tsx` — registry rows wrap with the revoke control on its own line; enrolment date in `--font-mono`; 24px before the unbranched enrolment CTA
- `app/(dashboard)/venues/[venueId]/staff/devices/components/revoke-device-dialog.tsx` — spinner through `Icon`; the same ordering contract comment

## Decisions Made

**The destructive control is widened from the page, not from the dialog.** The first pass added `className="w-full sm:w-auto"` to both dialog trigger buttons. On the revoke dialog that pushed the trigger's attributes onto separate lines, which re-wrapped the `aria-label={\`${COPY.revokeDevice.confirm}: ${label}\`}` line and so tripped the plan's "no COPY reference added, removed or re-ordered" gate on a change that moved no copy at all. Rather than argue the gate down, the trigger was left exactly as it was and the wrapper `div` on the page was made responsible for the line break. This is the better shape anyway: the two dialog components now contain no layout decision that belongs to the list rendering them, and a reviewer reading either destructive file sees a glyph swap and nothing else.

**Empty-state headings gained `font-heading`.** They were `text-heading` alone, which carried the size and weight but left the family at sans. `CardTitle` and `DialogTitle` both resolve the Heading role to `--font-serif`, so these two headings were the only Heading-role text on the surfaces rendering in the wrong family.

## Deviations from Plan

None — plan executed as written. The one course correction (the trigger `className` above) is recorded under Decisions Made rather than as a deviation: it was a first attempt within Task 2 that was superseded before the task was committed, so nothing outside the plan's five files was touched and no rule fired.

## Issues Encountered

**`tests/theme/build-assets.test.ts` failed on the first full-suite run (5 tests).** It asserts properties of the compiled CSS under `.next/`, and a fresh worktree has no build. Its own failure message says so explicitly. Running `pnpm build` first and re-running gave 728/728. This is a worktree-setup ordering fact, not a defect — but it is worth knowing that in a fresh worktree the suite is only meaningful after a build.

**Neither known-flaky file went red.** `tests/staff/pin-verify-backoff.test.ts` and `tests/actions/venue-authority.test.ts` — the two the standing overrides flag, and both squarely on this plan's surface — passed on every one of the three full runs.
